svg.title: Spiderweb wallet row counts
svg.desc: Rows 1 to 13 are the front and rows 14 to 26 are the back, each 17 stitches. The flap decreases at both ends: 15, 13, 11, 9, 7, 5, 3, then 1. A chain-8 loop returns to that last stitch.
svg.text: Counts that stay odd down to one stitch
Rows 1 to 13, front, 17 sc. Marker at row 13.
Rows 14 to 26, back, 17 sc. Marker at row 26.
An even count means one end was not decreased.
Chain 8 from the one stitch, slip stitch back
Test the button. Stay inside 7 to 10 chains.
